title: Keep chosen bits
summary: Assembly: Keep chosen bits. Try the even number 4.
introduction: and keeps only bits that are 1 in both inputs. A final bit of 1 marks an odd number.

blocks.text: On x86-64 Linux, save lesson.asm. Run nasm -f elf64 lesson.asm -o lesson.o, then ld lesson.o -o lesson. Run ./lesson, then printf 'exit code: %s\n' "$?" immediately.

blocks.title: Keep chosen bits
blocks.code:
global _start
section .text
_start:
    mov rdi, 5
    and rdi, 1
    mov rax, 60
    syscall

blocks.text: The binary form of 5 ends with 1. AND with 1 keeps only that bit.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Bitwise and is an operation on bits, not a high-level if statement.
